videos.description: Caroline faces an agonizing decision when she agrees to help a childhood friend whose illness threatens the life of her newborn baby.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: An elderly farmer (Lew Ayres) urges Almanzo to run for mayor to oppose Mrs. Oleson.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: The faith of the Walton family is sorely tried when Olivia contracts polio, and the doctor says that she may never walk again.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: Olivia tries a radical polio treatment developed by Sister Kenny of Australia.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: John-Boy heads for a mountain cabin to write, but ends up delivering an old schoolmate's (Sissy Spacek) baby.

videos.title: The Holiday Sitter
videos.description: Sam is a workaholic bachelor who's babysitting his niece and nephew during the holidays. Completely out of his element, he recruits help from a handsome neighbor and soon finds himself in an unexpected romance.

videos.title: A Family Christmas Gift
videos.description: When Amber spends the holidays with her Aunt Dora and helps plan a fundraising Christmas Concert, it brings Amber closer to her aunt and a new love into her life.

videos.title: A Perfect Christmas
videos.description: Newlyweds Steve and Cynthia have a few secrets to keep as their families arrive for the holidays: he's just been laid off, and she's pregnant.

videos.title: Christmas Everlasting
videos.description: Christmas is fast approaching and years of long workdays are about to pay off for Lucy. However, when her older sister unexpectedly passes away, Lucy dreads returning to Nilson's Bay to handle her sister's estate.

videos.title: Holiday Heritage
videos.description: Ella returns to her hometown to mend fences with her fractured family. With help from her ex-boyfriend, she encourages her family to celebrate Christmas and Kwanzaa and heal their past wounds before it's too late.

videos.title: Our Christmas Journey
videos.description: As a single mom and her teenage son come to a crossroad during Christmas, she must learn to let go so he can flourish as she finds her own heart healing in unexpected ways.

videos.title: Christmas in Evergreen: Bells Are Ringing
videos.description: As Michelle's wedding approaches, Hannah steps up to finish the new Evergreen museum's launch while questioning her future with Elliot.

videos.title: Meet Me at Christmas
videos.description: A woman tries to coordinate her son's Christmas Eve wedding with help from the bride's uncle.

videos.title: A Gingerbread Romance
videos.description: An architect begins to find herself longing for a place to call her own as she works alongside a baker to win a gingerbread house contest.

videos.title: A Heavenly Christmas
videos.description: A workaholic's (Kristin Davis) untimely death leads to her recruitment as a Christmas angel. Her first task is to help a struggling singer (Eric McCormack) use his music to heal old wounds.

videos.title: A Majestic Christmas
videos.description: An architect returns to her hometown during the holidays to turn a historic playhouse into a modern multiplex, much to the town's objections.

videos.title: The Christmas Bow
videos.description: When an accident puts her music dreams on hold, a gifted violinist reconnects with an old family friend, who helps her heal and find love during the holidays.

videos.title: Christmas in Harmony
videos.description: A music executive heads home to North Carolina to win her job back while also co-directing the church choir with her ex-boyfriend.

videos.title: Sister Swap: A Hometown Holiday
videos.description: Two sisters find a new sense of purpose and discover what they both truly need in life during the holidays.

videos.title: The Christmas House
videos.description: Working through some difficult decisions, a mother and father summon their two grown sons home for the holidays.

videos.title: My Christmas Love
videos.description: A hopeless romantic (Meredith Hagner) begins receiving the gifts from The 12 Days of Christmas from an anonymous suitor.

videos.title: Catch a Christmas Star
videos.description: A widower reconnects with his high school sweetheart, one of the country's biggest pop stars, with help from his two children.

videos.title: Christmas List
videos.description: Isobel makes a carefully composed bucket list of classic holiday traditions to celebrate with her boyfriend. But when he goes AWOL, the list proves challenging and a tempting new romance turns her life upside down.

videos.title: The Mistletoe Inn
videos.description: When an aspiring author is dumped by her soon-to-be-published novelist boyfriend, she decides to take a leap of faith and signs up for a romance writing retreat at a quaint Vermont Inn shortly before Christmas.

videos.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge
videos.description: A woman reunites with an old flame while trying to save a beloved bookstore.

videos.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge Part 2
videos.description: Molly and Ryan fell in love during their freshmen year only to break up when Molly's controlling father meddled in their romance. Seven years later, they are reunited when they try to save the bookstore that changed their lives.

videos.title: A Gift to Remember
videos.description: A hopeless romantic, Darcy, insists on being swept off her feet. One day, while bicycling to work, Darcy crashes into a sharply dressed man walking his dog. He falls into a coma; she takes the dog home, waiting to reunite him with his owner.

videos.title: 'Tis the Season for Love
videos.description: An out-of-work actress (Sarah Lancaster) finds romance after returning to her quaint hometown during Christmastime.

videos.title: Christmas Song
videos.description: Romance blossoms between two music teachers (Natasha Henstridge, Gabriel Hogan) who compete for the same job.

videos.description: Charles, Albert and Mr. Edwards follow the bank robbers who shot innocent bystander James.

videos.description: James and Alert are caught up in a nefarious gang's bank robbery while on a trip to Sleepy Eye.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Charles bids a tearful farewell to Laura after selling his small home and farm to John and Sarah Carter.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Jenny blames herself for Royal's death; Jeb Carter overcomes fear to save Jenny from drowning.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: A deranged man (Robert Loggia) attacks his wife and child, then takes Laura and her daughter hostage.

videos.title: Little House on the Prairie
videos.description: Mrs. Oleson's prejudice troubles a former circus dwarf (Billy Barty) who is trying to raise his daughter alone.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: John-Boy catches a friend stealing chickens, then learns that the man who was robbed has been shot.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: The family prepares for the county fair; Olivia has a visit from her childhood sweetheart (Peter Donat), now wealthy.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: A teenage orphan who once stayed with the Waltons returns with news of a tryout with a professional baseball scout.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: John-Boy becomes a rent collector for a neglectful, dishonest landlord; Erin nurses an orphaned fawn. Directed by Ralph Waite.

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: While the family makes Thanksgiving preparations, John-Boy awaits a visit from his girlfriend (Sian Barbara Allen).

videos.title: The Waltons
videos.description: A severe head injury, which prevented John-Boy from taking his college entrance exams, now requires surgery.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: When a group of orphans become stranded in Hope Valley for Christmas, their caretakers lead Bill to investigate the circumstances of their arrival.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: Abigail ushers in a new era by bringing telephones to Hope Valley; the saloon is in need of ownership; Elizabeth enjoys new motherhood, but returning to teaching proves challenging; Rosemary sees a potential romance between Faith and Carson.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: Carson has to admit that he cares more about Faith than he has let on; the whole town buzzes with curiosity about the charming new saloon owner, Lucas Bouchard; Elizabeth teaches a student the importance of taking a chance on oneself.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: After a judge is intimidated into releasing two gunrunners, Bill recruits an old friend to help him track the criminals down; Abigail and Lucas clash over the saloon's late hours; Carson and Faith must decide whether to pursue their feelings.

videos.title: When Calls the Heart
videos.description: A new Mountie arrives earlier than expected; Bill and Nathan jump right to work when Lee's payroll is stolen; at the school, friends turn against each other when a mock debate goes awry; Carson and Faith try to keep their romance a secret.
